mm7/banwiz-a.name: banwiz-a
mm7/banwiz-a.material: wall of tan-grey stone bricks with a hanging purple cloth banner with crenellated top, embroidered with a golden scroll, a wand and a golden serpent; copy the composition exactly

notes.2: the cloth is a deep, muted red-violet like dark plum, never bright blue-violet; the banner continues seamlessly into the sharp lower banner part below the bottom edge, same red-violet tone and weave, the side borders the same dark red knot pattern on black
notes.3: the two side border strips are dark: deep red interlaced knotwork on near-black, as dark as in the sharp lower banner part below the bottom edge, never orange or light red; the purple cloth has one even tone that continues seamlessly into the sharp part below
notes.4: the cloth is a true medium violet with as much red as blue, a little dusty, never blue-violet or ultramarine, exactly the violet of the sharp lower banner part below the bottom edge which it continues seamlessly; the two side border strips are deep red knotwork on near-black, as dark as below
notes.5: keep the banner, rod, crossed scroll and wand and the small serpent at exactly the reference's positions and sizes; the cloth is the reference's medium violet, as much red as blue, a little dusty, continuing seamlessly into the sharp lower banner part below the bottom edge; the side border strips are deep red knotwork on near-black
